Container.Name: Legejo
Container.Overview: Legejo is a self-hosted library for your EPUB books. Read in the browser, sync books, reading positions and highlights with a Kobo, use any OPDS reading app, and keep KOReader in step. Share shelves with other users, listen to audiobooks, and federate shelves of free books over ActivityPub so they can be followed from Mastodon or another Legejo. PDF files and comics (CBZ) are read in the browser too. Everything, the SQLite database included, lives in the appdata folder. Sign in with the admin user and password below; when the password is left empty, open the web UI and create the admin account there. Mail and the rest can then be set up on the Admin page.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ebook epub kobo opds koreader library reader audiobook calibre fediverse activitypub

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the web app, OPDS and the Kobo.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The library: database, book files, covers and audiobooks.

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: The first admin account, created on the first start together with the password below.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Its password, used only on the first start. Leave empty to create the admin account in the browser instead: the first visitor of the web UI is asked to make it.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address users reach Legejo on, e.g. https://books.example.org. Needed for federation and for links in mail; with https, session cookies are marked Secure. Leave empty for use on the local network.

Config.Name: Search inside the books
Config.Description: true keeps the text of the EPUBs in the database for searching inside them.

Config.Name: MCP server
Config.Description: true turns on the read-only MCP server for AI assistants at /api/mcp.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Mail server, for self-registration, invitations and password reset. Mail is off when empty.

Config.Name: Librarian API key
Config.Description: Key for an OpenAI-compatible language model; turns on the librarian, which suggests books. The account behind the key pays.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: Single sign-on with OpenID Connect; off when empty. See the README for the other LEGEJO_OIDC_* settings.
